items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: Kid Oren and Jack Carey used to buck all the time. They was known for that, those two, you know.

ctx.x: You remember any, uh, what they call battles of music sometime when you'd run into another? Oh yeah, yeah, yeah.

You'd call that bucking. Bucking. Yeah, yeah, you'd call that bucking. We'd run, there's Kid Oren them, oh, Kid Oren and Jack Carey used to buck all the time. They was known for that, those two, you know. They really used to pick on each other. Both played trombone, you know, and they both had their own band. And they always, one would try to outdo the other one. That was, uh, that was Jack Carey and Kid Oren. When you hear that they was going to advertise Jack Carey and Kid Oren, boy that was a lot of fun there.…
Um, how much did they get paid for those jobs on the street?
